title: Frequent
subtitle: 本課限定語境：frequent = happening often or many times · 「頻繁的；經常發生的」
description: 本課限定語境：frequent = happening often or many times · 「頻繁的；經常發生的」

words.note: 表示某事在某類情況中很常見。
words.example: Minor delays are common during the morning rush hour.
words.exampleZh: 早上繁忙時間出現輕微延誤很常見。

exercises.original: Minor delays are frequent during the morning rush hour.
exercises.zh: 早上繁忙時間出現輕微延誤很常見。
exercises.upgrade: Minor delays are common during the morning rush hour.

options.explanation: — 可表示反覆發生，但較正式，也更像同一問題一再出現。
— 重點是「繁忙時段中很常見」。
— 強度太高，表示幾乎不停。
— 延誤本身沒有「習慣」概念。

exercises.original: Small spelling mistakes are frequent in first drafts.
exercises.zh: 初稿中出現小型拼字錯誤很常見。
exercises.upgrade: Small spelling mistakes are common in first drafts.

options.explanation: — 表示這類錯誤在初稿中很普遍。
— 錯誤並非按固定間隔出現。

exercises.original: Headaches are a frequent complaint among people who work long hours at screens.
exercises.zh: 長時間使用螢幕的人經常出現頭痛這種常見不適。
exercises.upgrade: Headaches are a common complaint among people who work long hours at screens.

options.explanation: — a common complaint 是自然搭配。
— 更像同一個人的頭痛反覆復發。

words.note: 表示某事反覆出現，而且常有一定規律。

exercises.original: The machine needs frequent maintenance to remain reliable.
exercises.zh: 這台機器需要定期維修才能保持可靠。
exercises.upgrade: The machine needs regular maintenance to remain reliable.

options.explanation: — 通常形容再次出現的問題。
— 只表示做多次，未必有規律。
— 維修按固定安排反覆進行。

exercises.original: Managers hold frequent meetings to review progress.
exercises.zh: 經理定期開會檢討進度。
exercises.upgrade: Managers hold regular meetings to review progress.

exercises.original: The doctor recommended frequent check-ups after the operation.
exercises.zh: 醫生建議手術後定期覆診檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The doctor recommended regular check-ups after the operation.

options.explanation: — 不自然形容按計劃進行的 check-ups。
— 醫療覆診按安排反覆進行。

words.meaning: 反覆出現的；一再發生的
words.note: 表示某個問題、事件或主題一再回來。
words.example: The team has been dealing with recurring technical problems.
words.exampleZh: 團隊一直在處理反覆出現的技術問題。

exercises.original: The team has been dealing with frequent technical problems.
exercises.zh: 團隊一直在處理反覆出現的技術問題。
exercises.upgrade: The team has been dealing with recurring technical problems.

options.explanation: — 同類 technical problems 一再回來。
— 像按安排發生，不適合問題。

exercises.original: The company is trying to solve a frequent complaint from customers.
exercises.zh: 公司正嘗試解決顧客反覆提出的投訴。
exercises.upgrade: The company is trying to solve a recurring complaint from customers.

options.explanation: — 同一類投訴反覆再次出現。
— 通常形容人的習慣性行為。

exercises.original: Payment failures have become a frequent issue for some users.
exercises.zh: 付款失敗已成為部分使用者反覆遇到的問題。
exercises.upgrade: Payment failures have become a recurring issue for some users.

options.explanation: — 表示普遍，不突出再次發生。

words.note: 表示某件事做了或發生了不止一次。
words.exampleZh: 多次延誤令人非常沮喪。

exercises.original: Frequent delays eventually caused customers to complain.
exercises.zh: 多次延誤最終令顧客投訴。
exercises.upgrade: Repeated delays eventually caused customers to complain.

options.explanation: — 重點只是延誤發生了多次。
— 也接近，但更像同一問題持續回來。

exercises.original: The device failed after frequent attempts to restart it.
exercises.zh: 裝置在多次重新啟動後仍告失敗。
exercises.upgrade: The device failed after repeated attempts to restart it.

exercises.original: The warning was ignored despite frequent reminders.
exercises.zh: 儘管多次提醒，警告仍被忽視。
exercises.upgrade: The warning was ignored despite repeated reminders.

options.explanation: — 若按固定日程發出才更合適。
— 較少形容 reminder 本身。

words.note: 較正式，表示某種情況重複出現。
words.example: The system suffers from recurrent faults.
words.exampleZh: 這套系統反覆出現故障。

exercises.original: The system suffers from frequent faults during periods of heavy use.
exercises.zh: 系統在高使用量期間反覆出現故障。
exercises.upgrade: The system suffers from recurrent faults during periods of heavy use.

options.explanation: — 較正式地表示故障反覆復發。

exercises.original: The patient reported frequent episodes of the same symptoms.
exercises.zh: 病人表示同樣症狀反覆發作。
exercises.upgrade: The patient reported recurrent episodes of the same symptoms.

options.explanation: — 表示不中斷，和 episodes 衝突。

exercises.original: The organization has struggled with frequent funding shortages.
exercises.zh: 該機構一直面對反覆出現的資金短缺。
exercises.upgrade: The organization has struggled with recurrent funding shortages.

options.explanation: — 只有按固定週期出現才更精確。
— 正式表示同一類問題一再發生。
— 不突出同一機構反覆遇到。

words.meaning: 頻繁不斷的；反覆持續的
words.note: 表示某事長時間反覆發生，中間可以有短暫間隔。
words.example: Continual interruptions made it difficult to concentrate.
words.exampleZh: 不斷出現的打擾令人難以集中。

exercises.original: Frequent interruptions made it difficult to concentrate.
exercises.zh: 不斷反覆的打擾令人難以集中。
exercises.upgrade: Continual interruptions made it difficult to concentrate.

options.explanation: — 也可，但 continual 更突出持續困擾。
— 副詞，而且 continuous 與 continual 不同。

exercises.original: The project was slowed by frequent changes to the requirements.
exercises.zh: 要求不斷反覆改變，拖慢了項目進度。
exercises.upgrade: The project was slowed by continual changes to the requirements.

options.explanation: — 強調改動長時間一再發生。
— 容易變成中性安排意味。

exercises.original: Frequent complaints from neighbours made the venue reconsider its opening hours.
exercises.zh: 鄰居不斷投訴，令場地重新考慮營業時間。
exercises.upgrade: Continual complaints from neighbours made the venue reconsider its opening hours.

options.explanation: — 也可，但 continual 更突出長期一再發生。
— 符合反覆、持續造成壓力的語境。

words.meaning: 持續不斷的；極其頻繁的
words.note: 表示某事幾乎一直存在或不停發生。
words.example: The constant noise made it hard to sleep.
words.exampleZh: 持續不斷的噪音令人難以入睡。

exercises.original: The frequent noise from construction made it difficult to sleep.
exercises.zh: 施工噪音幾乎持續不斷，令人難以入睡。
exercises.upgrade: The constant noise from construction made it difficult to sleep.

exercises.original: She was frustrated by frequent interruptions throughout the entire meeting.
exercises.zh: 整場會議幾乎不停被打斷，令她很沮喪。
exercises.upgrade: She was frustrated by constant interruptions throughout the entire meeting.

options.explanation: — throughout the entire meeting 支持極高頻率。

exercises.original: The support team receives frequent messages all day long.
exercises.zh: 支援團隊整天幾乎不停收到訊息。
exercises.upgrade: The support team receives constant messages all day long.

options.explanation: — 不符合 all day long 的密集感。
— 表示常見，不是訊息流量。

words.note: 表示某種行為因習慣而經常發生。
words.example: His habitual lateness annoyed his colleagues.
words.exampleZh: 他習慣性遲到令同事不滿。

exercises.original: His frequent lateness has become a problem for the team.
exercises.zh: 他習慣性遲到已成為團隊問題。
exercises.upgrade: His habitual lateness has become a problem for the team.

options.explanation: — 可暗示經常，但不如 habitual 明確指出習慣。
— lateness 是人的反覆行為且形成習慣。
— 較正式，常用於問題／症狀。
— 表示遲到普遍，不是他個人的習慣。

exercises.original: Frequent checking of his phone made it hard for him to focus.
exercises.zh: 他習慣性查看手機令他難以集中精神。
exercises.upgrade: Habitual checking of his phone made it hard for him to focus.

options.explanation: — 不如 habitual 適合人的行為。

exercises.original: The coach warned him about his frequent tendency to skip warm-ups.
exercises.zh: 教練警告他不要習慣性跳過熱身。
exercises.upgrade: The coach warned him about his habitual tendency to skip warm-ups.

options.explanation: — 可指問題反覆出現，但不如 habitual 強調個人習慣。
— his tendency + repeated behavior 最自然。

words.note: 表示某事隔一段時間再次發生，通常有可辨認的間隔。

exercises.original: The equipment needs frequent inspections every six months.
exercises.zh: 設備每六個月需要一次週期性檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The equipment needs periodic inspections every six months.

options.explanation: — 也很自然，但 periodic 更明確表示按間隔發生。
— every six months 是明確週期線索。

exercises.original: The system performs frequent automatic checks at set intervals.
exercises.zh: 系統按設定間隔進行週期性自動檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The system performs periodic automatic checks at set intervals.

options.explanation: — at set intervals 直接定義 periodic。

exercises.original: The organization publishes frequent reviews throughout the year on a fixed schedule.
exercises.zh: 該機構按固定時間表在全年發布週期性檢討。
exercises.upgrade: The organization publishes periodic reviews throughout the year on a fixed schedule.

options.explanation: — 沒有固定間隔意味那麼強。
— 也很自然；periodic 更突出週期。
— 作形容詞雖存在，但此處 periodic 更自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 普遍存在 ≠ 頻繁發生 prevalent 表示在群體／地區很普遍，不一定表示同一事件多次發生。

falseSynonyms.point: numerous = many in number；frequent = happening often。

falseSynonyms.zh: 連續不斷 ≠ 頻繁 continuous 強調完全不中斷；frequent 可以中間有間隔。
持續存在 ≠ 經常發生 persistent 常表示問題長時間不消失。
例行的 ≠ 必然頻繁 routine 可以每月甚至每年一次。
通常的 ≠ 頻繁的 usual 表示正常／慣常，不一定涉及發生次數。
- frequent = 形容詞 - frequently = 副詞 - frequency = 名詞
- recur = 再次發生 - recurring = 反覆出現的 - recurrent = 反覆發生的，較正式 - recurrence = 再次出現／復發
